{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Galbrena |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = {{Extra Effect|Chimera|Chimera|A Tidespawn created by Leviathan. It is a fusion of the frequencies of three powerful Tacet Discords: the great lion "Nemea," the ancestral goat "Pan," and the slippery serpent "Python." Once Leviathan's "first offspring," it now "resides" within Galbrena after merging with her frequency.
Within this fused being, the lion's brutal nature dominates Chimera's will, while the goat tempers its violence by feeding on human compassion. The serpent, sly and independent, appears loyal to Galbrena but secretly undermines her frequency.}} feeds on my soul. To replenish what he takes, I hunt {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}} for their frequencies. Even without a pact, he would still find a way to take from me. So I made a choice. Not to resist, but to become part of him. Only flames survive flames. Now, forged in hellfire, this body burns even brighter. As for Chimera and the other Tacet Discords who thought they were so tough? They must learn to live in my fire. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = An incarnate of hellfire, fed on demons, commanding the power of the {{Extra Effect|Dark Tide|Dark Tide|A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Rinascita, the Dark Tide is a manifestation of the Threnodian Leviathan's power of Unity. Dark clouds amass overhead and crash down like a waterfall, surging in all directions. Wherever the Dark Tide spreads, it spawns Tacet Discords and scars the land with Tidal Blight. At its epicenter, a new Tacet Field forms.}}. This is who I am. Will you fear me… or scorn me? They call my power a curse, an ancient omen of darkness. But I call it something else—an oath. I know what I have to do. And no matter how the world may judge me, I will see it through to the very end. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Many call me "Galbrena," and I've grown used to it. It's the name of my second life. Hey, if it gets the job done, I don't mind it. But Angel... that name has always stayed with me. It was given to me by my parents, outcasts from Ragunna who hoped I'd grow into it one day. Since then, I've crossed many lands, seen my share of "monsters and demons"... but never angels. They say angels exist to fight devils. And where an angel goes, danger follows. They may not look like people think. Sometimes they scare you. Sometimes they warn you. If that's what an angel is… maybe I have lived up to that name after all. So tell me. What do you see? |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Along my journey, I've stopped a lot of tragedies... and watched just as many unfold, both natural and man-made. This world isn't always beautiful. And that's exactly why the bonds we make in it feel all the more precious. Like you, I load my gun for the ones who never made it home. I wasn't the first. And I won't be the last. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = The showdown between me and {{Extra Effect|Chimera}} will come, sooner or later. If the worst happens that day... then I want you to hunt me. Heh, don't worry. I never said I'd let Chimera win. Besides, I've got one more reason to win now. |vo_02_01_title = Galbrena's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = The sky offers a wide, unbroken view. From up there, I see everything—prey included. The moment they slip up, I strike, swift and silent. There's something... in watching from above. Keeps me away from crowds, too... I bring fear only when it's called for. |vo_02_02_title = Galbrena's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Galbrena: I can keep {{Extra Effect|Chimera}} in check most of the time… but the second I'm distracted, he always finds a way to—
Chimera: You never talk this much to anyone else.
Galbrena: …Like that. I speak more when the person doesn't grate on me.
Chimera: You talk to me often. Do I count?
Galbrena: First of all, you don't count as a "person."
Chimera: Then just admit it—even you fear being alone. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Sorbet, shaved ice, gelato… they're pretty much the same. The hellfire inside me never dies down. Cold things help keep it in check. But an added bit of sweetness works even better. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = At first, I "ate" {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords}} just to survive. But now, I hunt them for power... They don't count as food? Well, if we're talking about food in the usual sense, I can stomach anything on the table. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Live well. Die right. That's how I see it. And if there really is an afterlife, where I get to see "them" again… I want to face them with pride. To say I lived fully. Fought for what I believed in. Died with meaning. No regrets, nothing unfinished. But until my flame burns out, I'll keep crossing death, again and again. And when it's time... I'll offer whatever spark is left, and gladly embrace the end. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = I was born in Septimont. It taught me how to fight, and to this day, I still trust in that. But most weapons don't hold up against the {{Extra Effect|Dark Tide}}. Its corruption gets in deep, eats them from the inside out. For a long time, I fought Tacet Discords bare-handed. Then I got my hands on these guns. Took a hell of a fight to pry them out of {{Extra Effect|Chimera}}'s jaws. He'd been hoarding them the whole time. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = You've seen what I was in the Dark Tide. As for what came after, it was just hunt or be hunted. I fell, I got back up, again and again, until the hunt ended. Then I'd brush the embers off my shoulders just like this, and move onto the next hunting ground. Met different people. Saw different things. Oh, and sometimes... I'd stop to find a place to grab ice cream. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Augusta]] |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Augusta.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Augusta... she was my childhood friend. Back then, I'd usually sit quietly under a tree, lost in my own thoughts. She'd be off swinging her sword, shouting about becoming the next Hero of Heroes. She loved dragging me into sparring matches... We'd often end up scuffling into the {{Extra Effect|Fabianum|Fabianum|The past name of "Murmurstown." Devastated sixteen years ago by the outbreak of the Dark Tide, it is now a lost Gladiator town in the Wastelands.}} rivers, and when we got tired, we'd lie on the riverbank letting the cool water soak us completely. Now... time has changed a lot. But thankfully, not all of it for the worse. Augusta became exactly the kind of ruler Septimont needed. |vo_04_01_mention = Augusta |vo_04_02_title = About [[Cartethyia]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Cartethyia.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = It was through the {{Extra Effect|Dark Tide}}'s memory that I first learned of her. I never saw her as anyone's Resonator, and in return, she gave me a reply that was... wild, reckless, but resolute. A knight of justice shouldn't be sealed away in a tower. The nightmare Leviathan cast upon her lasted far too long… But now that {{Extra Effect|Rinascita|Rinascita|A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.
Legends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.}} has emerged from the darkness, she too should be free to embrace her own dawn. |vo_04_02_mention = Cartethyia |vo_04_03_title = About [[Aalto]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Aalto.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = {{Extra Effect|The Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}}' database needs constant updates, and I send captured Tacet Discord data back like clockwork. I don't visit the base much, so Aalto is the one who always helps handle my performance check-ins. Of course, he never signs off on anything that doesn't benefit him. That's why half the data I send ends up counted as his work. |vo_04_03_mention = Aalto |vo_04_04_title = About [[Calcharo]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Calcharo.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = While hunting in the New Federation, we had our eyes on the same Tacet Discord. His goal was to eliminate it. Mine was to absorb it. There were some misunderstandings along the way, but overall, it was a smooth collaboration. He actually invited me to join his mercenary group. Pack hunting is indeed important to survival, but... I'm just used to working alone. |vo_04_04_mention = Calcharo |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday. Instead of saying, "Congrats on escaping another year in time's hunt," I'd rather say, "Here's to happy hunting in the time you've got." Here, this necklace is for you. Think of it as a talisman. It holds every story I've lived through. The plain metal badge once saved me when I was shot in the heart. The seashell comes from a lost civilization. You can still hear its echoes if you listen close. And this "tear" of glass, forged in fire and shed from a war machine... There's a lot more. If you want, I can tell you all about them. Next year, I'll even bring some new charms to add. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Ever armed. Ever burning. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = {{Extra Effect|Chimera}}: Ah, a fresh delicacy...
Galbrena: Back off. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Who's my next prey? |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Galbrena. Ready to join the hunt. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Let the gunshots ring. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = I'm here. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = An unusual way to gain strength... thanks. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = ...You didn't need to do this just for my power. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Hah... what now? Trying to make a pact with the "devil"? |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = My path is mine alone. It's long. Perilous. No light. No company. I won't always be around… And the "devil" will want its pound of flesh. For a pact this unfair... Are you sure you can accept it? |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = This blood... let it drip into your palm. There. Now our "pact" is sealed. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Galbrena |language = en |basic_1_tx = Galbrena: Fight fire with fire.
